mechanism: merge._verify_for_landing calls the verifier in the base engine process with the lane as the repository root.
The base runtime editable .pth points to base/src. The lane proof refuses that external import path.
A successful suite with an unavailable proof cannot produce a trusted pytest receipt.
loop._record_verify already passes the landing report into the base verifier.
The base verifier must execute when neither the receipt nor its local cache proves matching inputs.
The work_repo fixture copies build/lefthook when present. Its presence is an actual test input.

artifact_control.observed_failure: The commit hook refused projection-hooks because the new lane lacked pinned Lefthook archives.
artifact_control.repair: Prepared the lane archives with lefthook_artifacts.py --from-dir using the existing local verified version directory.
artifact_control.limit: This removes one preparation difference. It does not establish runtime or environment equivalence.

counterexample.conclusion: Ignoring the external import refusal can reuse evidence after a material source change.

decision.implementation: No verifier or cache change is justified by this evidence.
decision.next_boundary: Establish an explicit execution and dependency contract across checkouts before extending receipt eligibility.
decision.parent_state: Leave the parent open. Do not reopen completed children or cut a release.
